Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities,

IS: 6257 -1982 



Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SHELL END MILLS 

( First Revision ) 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and requirements for solid shell end mills with plain bore and cross 
slot 

1.1 This standard is not applicable to shell end mills with inserted blades, either solid in steel, or fitted 
with brazed or mechanically fixed tips.

IS: 6257 -1982 

3. General Requirements 

3.1 Unless specified otherwise, shell end mills shall have right hand helicoidal teeth, for right hand 
cutting. 

3.2 The dimensions for tenon sfots shall be according to IS : 6310*1971 'Dimensions for interchangeability 
of milling cutters and milling arbors with tenon drive 9 . 

3.3 The shell end mill may also be supplied with chip breakers according to profile * R ' or profile ' F * as 
shown in figures below, if desired by the purchaser. 



^??^^ 





PROFILE R PR0F,LE F 

CHIP BREAKER WITH SINUSOIDAL CHIP BREAKER WITH FLAT 

PROFILE PROFILE 

Note — Profile * R ' is meant for roughing operation and profile * F ' for roughing and finishing operation. 

3.4 For requirements not covered in this standard, it shall conform to the requirements as given in IS: 
1830-1982 'Technical supply conditions for milling cutters (second revision)'. 

4. Sampling — The sampling and criteria of acceptance shall be in accordance with IS: 7778-1975 
'Methods for sampling small tools'. 

5. Designation —A shell end mill having diameter D = 63 mm of tool-type * N • for right hand cutting, 
made of high speed steel and conforming to this standard shall be designated as : 

Shell End Mill 63 IS : 6257 

5.1 When the shell end mill is required with tool-type other than *N\ the tool-type H or S, as 
appropriate shall be added in the designation immediately after the size. 

Example ; 

A shell end mill having diameter D = 63 mm of tool-type 'H* for right hand cutting, made of 
high speed steel and conforming to this standard shall be designated as : 

Shell End Mil) 63 H IS : 6257 

5.2 When the shell end mill is required with chip breakers of profile ' R * or profile * F ', the same shall be 
added in the designation after the size. 

Example : 

A shell end mill having diameter D = 63 mm of tool-type H for right hand profile with chip 
breaker of profile 'R\ made of high speed steel and conforming to this standard shall be 
designated as : 

Shell End Mill 63 HR IS : 6257 

6. Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1971. The present revision is necessitated, to bring it in line 
with the work done at ISO level. 

In the preparation of this standard considerable assistance has been derived from the following 
standards: 

ISO 2586-1973 Shell end mills with plain bore and tenon drive — Metric series, international 
Organization for Standardization. 

DIN 1680-1976 Walzenstirnfraser mit Quernut (Shell end mills with tenon drive). Deutsches 
Institut fiir Normung.
